name: Face Off

features.name: Retriggers
features.description: Three scatters in the bonus add five spins.

review:
Face Off is a Halloween Bonanza-style slot where four masked maniacs lurk in a graveyard. Scatters pay whenever they land in the main game, and symbols pay anywhere with refills.

Tombstone multipliers appear only during free spins, each taking a random value from 2x to 100x that applies to the win. Three or more scatters in the bonus add five more spins. Chance x2 and a bonus buy are available where permitted. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 15,000x maximum and a 95.97% RTP. Free spins are rare, arriving about once every 395 spins on average.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
